Clearing local profile data with regedit seems to have fixed this. Clearing it with in-game menu doesn't fix the problem.  
So the cause of the problem might be related to something in local profile data which wouldn't be cleared with "Clear all local profile data" in-game menu.

Possibly related? https://vrchat.canny.io/vrchat-udon-closed-alpha-bugs/p/interactive-objects-break-after-being-clonedinstanciated-on-live-worlds
EDIT: This bug seems to be caused by having your "first" world (either your home or the world you launch vrchat with through the website) be an SDK3 world. If your first world is an SDK2 world, pickups work as expected. I think clearing profile data as @Death suggested works because it sends you to the VRChat tutorial (an SDK2 world) on launch.

details:
Version: VRChat client 2020.1.1p5, build 924
Description of the bug:
In some worlds, usually Udon worlds, some players will not be able to interact with spawned objects.  
I went into  some Udon worlds with a group of friends. Me and some of my friends can't interact with the spawned objects, and cannot see those objects other people spawned. The people who can pick up objects can also see the objects other people spawned.  
Upon checking the log I found that when the objects were spawned, VRC_ObjectSync, VRC_Pickup, and VRC_EventHandler were removed from the objects.  
The problem seems to be tied to the PC, people who have problem will always have that problem.  
I don't think it's the driver issue as I'm using AMD VGA and another friend who has the issue is using nVidia VGA.
Things I've tried in order to fix this bug ( but doesn't work )
- restart the game
- change avatars
- change safety level to none, avatar performance to VeryPoor, and remove dynamic bone usage limit
- switching between Desktop, VR, and VR mode on desktop
- Change the resolution, graphic quality settings, windowed/fullscreen mode
- Restart my PC
- Verify integrity of game files via steam
- Delete cache, clear local profile data, both in-game and manually
- Disable Radeon Graphic settings for VRChat
- Created another account to test, the bug still occured
Steps to reproduce : Just go into any world that let player spawn objects ( like UNO VR ) and spawn them.
First noticed in Attack of the Giants ( wrld_cb004ddd-d4b4-4df7-8cd2-142dd31b2477 )
This is what happened in the log
2020.05.08 03:47:58 Log        -  [VRCFlowManagerVRC] Readying all objects
2020.05.08 03:47:58 Warning    -  [Always] Removing VRC_ObjectSync comp from CLUB v2 1
2020.05.08 03:47:58 Warning    -  [Always] Removing VRC_Pickup comp from CLUB v2 1
2020.05.08 03:47:58 Warning    -  [Always] Removing VRC_EventHandler comp from CLUB v2 1
title: ObjectSync, Pickup, EventHandle removed on object spawn
